Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch19-fig-19-4-chromosome-organization (drawn for this lesson after the printed figure; not the textbook's picture). The printed figure shows 1,400 nm on one chromatid; drawn as 700 nm for the chromatid, as the book's text says, with 1,400 nm across both chromatids of the whole chromosome (correct).

findings: The book counts DNA length in nucleotides (146 per nucleosome, 80 in linker DNA, 140 million per chromosome); these are base pairs of double-stranded DNA. Linker length varies (often 20-80 base pairs). Kept as printed.
'DNA is a negatively charged' is copied as printed (a slip, not marked). The Tidbit on heterochromatin and euchromatin is carried.

Figure 19.4 prints 1,400 nm on one chromatid while the book's text gives the chromatid as 700 nm thick; 1,400 nm is the width of both chromatids together. The original drawing labels the chromatid 700 nm and puts 1,400 nm across the whole chromosome, and the Roman Urdu lesson notes the correction.
